title: LivingBookManifestV1
description: Minimal declarative manifest for a Living Book instance under the Living Book Factory.

id.description: Unique identifier slug for the Living Book.

title.description: Main title of the Living Book.

canonical_host.description: Target canonical public host / FQDN (e.g. institut.acorsica.org).

language.description: Primary ISO language code (e.g. fr, en).

publisher.description: Legal or associative carrier / publisher (e.g. C.O.R.S.I.C.A.).

research_unit.description: Affiliated research entity or laboratory (e.g. Institut Mariani).

book.description: Whether the durable long-arc synthesis (Book/Manuscript) is enabled.

magazine.description: Whether the continuous delta journal (Magazine) is enabled.

site.description: Whether the public reading projection (Site) is enabled.

guide.description: Whether the public Cogentia Guide profile is enabled.

contributions.description: Whether controlled contribution surfaces are enabled.

janus.description: Whether the Janus double temporality (reconstruction vs prospective) is enabled.

sources.description: Source Living Book IDs for federated syndication.

extensions.description: Declared optional extensions (e.g. chronology, people-registry, accounting, living-book-press, cases).
